artworks.title: Theia (Pergamon Altar, south frieze)
artworks.description: Theia on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar — the Titaness of shining light fighting among the gods in Hellenistic high relief. Pergamonmuseum, Berlin.

artworks.title: Theia on the Pergamon Altar
artworks.description: A second view of Theia's combat group on the same frieze — drapery and stride identifying the mother of Helios, Selene and Eos among the Titan allies.

popCulture.title: Theia (planet)
popCulture.description: Modern astronomy named the hypothesized impact-body that formed the Moon after the Titaness — Theia's light carried into deep time.
